maturity_note: Stable core API; coding engines and extensions retain their documented subsystem boundaries. See the docs maturity table.
canonical_import: from lazybridge import Agent, ClaudeCodeEngine, CodexEngine, LLMEngine, Plan, Step, Tool, Memory, Store, Session, SessionRegistry

canonical_patterns.sequential_plan: agent = Agent(engine=Plan(Step('research'), Step('write')), tools=[research_agent, write_agent], name='pipeline')
canonical_patterns.parallel_fanout:
fan = Agent.parallel(researcher, analyst)
env = fan('topic')           # one Envelope with labelled text
env.text()
# For list[Envelope], use await fan.run_branches('topic') instead.
canonical_patterns.chain: pipe = Agent.chain(researcher, writer)   # linear Plan shortcut
canonical_patterns.agent_as_tool: tools=[other_agent]              # auto-wrapped; other_agent.name is the tool name
canonical_patterns.coding_review:
reviewer = Agent(name='reviewer', engine=CodexEngine(system='Return approved or rejected: <reason>.'))
writer = Agent(name='writer', engine=ClaudeCodeEngine(), verify=reviewer, max_verify=3)
canonical_patterns.async_entry_point: result = await agent.run('do the thing'); result.text()

envelope_contract.payload: result.payload -> T — typed payload when output= was set; otherwise str
envelope_contract.error: result.error -> ErrorInfo | None — reported runtime failure; result.ok is execution success, not review acceptance
envelope_contract.metadata: result.metadata.cost_usd / input_tokens / output_tokens / latency_ms / model / provider / run_id / nested_*

avoid: LazyTool — renamed to tool() factory in 0.7.x
LazyContext — replaced by sentinels / Store / Memory in 0.7.x
mode="auto" — Tool.__init__ rejects this since 0.7.9; pass mode="signature", "llm", or "hybrid"
Agent.from_chain / from_engine / from_model / from_plan / from_parallel — all five deleted in 0.7.9 (alias-only); use Agent(engine=...) or Agent.chain / Agent.parallel
AgentRuntimeConfig / ResilienceConfig / ObservabilityConfig — deleted in 0.7.9; pass the fields as flat kwargs on Agent(...)
Writing JSON schemas by hand for annotated Python functions — tool() introspects type hints automatically
MCP.stdio(...) without allow= or deny= — deny-by-default since 0.7.9, raises ValueError
asyncio.run(main()) in quickstarts — Agent.__call__ auto-detects event loops
lazybridge.external_tools.report_builder — extracted to selvaz/LazyReport in 0.7.9; install lazybridge-reports separately

tools_vs_native_tools.tools=: Python functions, named sub-Agents, ToolProvider instances and schema-backed Tools. LazyTools owns MCP connectors. Claude exposes tools through in-process MCP; Codex uses App Server dynamic tools. Native read-only settings do not sandbox Python tools.
tools_vs_native_tools.native_tools=: Provider-side tools the LLM invokes via the vendor's native API (web search, code execution, etc.).  Pass a NativeTool enum value, e.g. native_tools=[NativeTool.WEB_SEARCH].  Dangerous tools (CODE_EXECUTION, COMPUTER_USE) require allow_dangerous_native_tools=True.

coding_continuity.claude: persist_session/session_id; session_alias/session_registry. session_name labels a runtime-mode slot on Session, not a native title.
coding_continuity.codex: persist_thread/thread_id; session_alias/session_registry. Ephemeral thread ids are not resumable.
coding_continuity.state: Reuse Python Memory/Store/Session references when changing engines. Native Claude transcripts and Codex threads do not migrate across engines.
coding_continuity.locks: Durable runs/streams serialize within an event loop. Registry file locks do not protect native transcripts across processes.
coding_continuity.verify: Construction-time judge; max_verify counts total attempts. Unknown verdicts reject; exhaustion returns the last output without an approval flag. Select the opposite engine explicitly and use deterministic release checks.
coding_continuity.writes: Claude needs extra_tools as well as policy; writer(gate) does not add Write/Edit/Bash. Bash is not confined by file_roots. Codex uses workspace-write and optional writable_roots.

integrations.namespace: Distribution lazytoolkit; import lazytools. lazybridge.ext.mcp/gateway and external_tools shims were removed in 0.9.

default_model_advice: Use Agent.from_provider('anthropic', tier='top') in quickstarts so the example stays current as providers ship new SKUs.  Pin a specific model id (e.g. 'claude-opus-5') only when the example tests a model-specific behaviour.

tier_aliases_anthropic_2026_09.note: claude-sonnet-5-5 (GA 2026-09-28) replaced claude-sonnet-5 as the 'medium' tier alias, same $2/$10 pricing. claude-mythos-5-1 exists (same pricing as Fable 5.1) but is restricted to vetted partners (Project Glasswing) and is deliberately not aliased to any tier.  claude-3-haiku is retired.

effort_parameter: ThinkingConfig.effort accepts 'low'|'medium'|'high'|'xhigh'|'max' and is read by both AnthropicProvider (sent as output_config.effort — Fable 5/5.1, Mythos 5/5.1, Opus 5.5/5, Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 5.5/5/4.6, Opus 4.5) and OpenAIProvider (sent as reasoning.effort / reasoning_effort on every gpt-5.x and o-series model). LLMEngine(model, thinking='low') is shorthand for LLMEngine(model, thinking=ThinkingConfig(enabled=True, effort='low')).
